dcterms:description: A dataset involving classifying a question sentence into six types, with a predefined train-test split. It contains 5452 training samples and 500 testing samples, with 10% of the training data held out for validation.
dcterms:title: TREC Question Dataset

dcterms:description: The Stanford Sentiment Treebank dataset SST-1 contains one sentence movie reviews rated on a scale of 1-5 from positive to negative. It has a predefined train-test-dev split with 8544 training samples, 2210 testing samples, and 1101 validation samples. SST-2 is a binary version with only two labels: positive and negative, containing 6920 training samples, 1821 testing samples, and 872 validation samples.
dcterms:title: Stanford Sentiment Treebank (SST-1 and SST-2)
